hook_text: An isosceles triangle with a 40° top. Find the other angles in two moves.
clip_script: The top pane of the window is an isosceles triangle with a top angle of forty degrees between its two equal sides. The base angles are equal, and together they make 180 minus forty, 140 degrees. So each base angle is seventy degrees.
visual_style: A stained-glass triangle glows; the 40° top angle lights up; 140° splits into two 70° base angles with matching arcs; a 180° check appears.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to solve kites, rectangles and parallelograms too.
